svg.title: VersionTaskTracker thumbnail
svg.desc: A terminal window showing a project tree. The VersionTaskTracker.Cli directory carries two tasks, Runtime Environment and Add logging, both marked TODO. Tasks are stored in .vtt/tasks.db, and the prompt shows the command vtt task list.
